properties.description: Selects exactly one preferred, latest, or specific version, rejects duplicate preferred/version identities, and builds the item route.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
name, selection, organizationMoid = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[5]
requestedVersion = int(sys.argv[4])
rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Definition version selected", "{}", False
definitionMoid = ""
selectedVersion = 0
definitionItemUrl = ""
try:
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Definition response does not contain a Results array.")
    exact = [row for row in rows if row.get("Name") == name and isinstance(row.get("Organization"), dict) and row["Organization"].get("Moid") == organizationMoid]
    versions = [int(row.get("Version", 0)) for row in exact]
    if len(exact) != len(rows):
        status, statusCode, message = "identity-mismatch", 409, "Definition response contains an identity outside the exact requested filter."
        chosen = []
    elif len(versions) != len(set(versions)):
        status, statusCode, message = "conflict", 409, "The definition family contains duplicate version identities."
        chosen = []
    elif selection == "Preferred":
        chosen = [row for row in exact if row.get("PreferredVersion") is True]
    elif selection == "Specific":
        chosen = [row for row in exact if int(row.get("Version", 0)) == requestedVersion]
    else:
        chosen = [] if not exact else [max(exact, key=lambda row: int(row.get("Version", 0)))]
    if status == "ok" and len(chosen) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(chosen) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(chosen) == 0 else 409
        message = "Version selection must identify exactly one definition; received %d." % len(chosen)
    if status == "ok":
        definitionMoid = str(chosen[0].get("Moid") or "")
        selectedVersion = int(chosen[0].get("Version", 0))
        if not definitionMoid or selectedVersion < 1:
            raise ValueError("Selected definition has no Moid.")
        definitionItemUrl = "/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions/" + definitionMoid
        resultJson = json.dumps({"selected": chosen[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "familyVersionCount": len(exact)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

properties.description: Verifies the item identity, requires one metadata relationship, de-duplicates blueprint Moids, and prepares scoped child reads.
properties.display_name: Verify definition identity and prepare relationships
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Definition identity verified", "{}", False
definitionJson = metadataUrl = metadataMoid = blueprintUrl = blueprintMoidsJson = ""
blueprintCount = 0
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid, organizationMoid = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    organization = body.get("Organization") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(body, dict) or body.get("Moid") != expectedMoid or body.get("Name") != sys.argv[4] or int(body.get("Version", 0)) != int(sys.argv[5]) or not isinstance(organization, dict) or organization.get("Moid") != organizationMoid:
        status, statusCode, message = "identity-mismatch", 409, "Definition item identity or organization does not match the selected resource."
    else:
        metadata = body.get("WorkloadMetadata")
        metadataMoid = metadata.get("Moid") if isinstance(metadata, dict) else ""
        if not metadataMoid:
            status, statusCode, message = "relationship-missing", 422, "Selected definition has no usable WorkloadMetadata relationship."
        else:
            moids = []
            for entry in body.get("Blueprints") or []:
                relation = entry.get("Blueprint") if isinstance(entry, dict) else None
                moid = relation.get("Moid") if isinstance(relation, dict) else ""
                if not moid or moid in moids:
                    status, statusCode, message = "relationship-invalid", 422, "Blueprint relationships must contain distinct non-empty Moids."
                    break
                moids.append(moid)
            if status == "ok":
                definitionJson = json.dumps(body, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
                metadataUrl = "/api/v1/workload/WorkloadMetadata/" + metadataMoid
                clauses = ["Moid eq '%s'" % value for value in moids]
                blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=" + (" or ".join(clauses) if clauses else "Moid eq '000000000000000000000000'")
                blueprintMoidsJson = json.dumps(moids, separators=(",", ":"))
                blueprintCount = len(moids)
                resultJson = definitionJson
    if status != "ok":
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

        resultJson = baseResultJson
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

properties.description: Requires the returned blueprint Moid set to equal the relationship set exactly and attaches details in relationship order.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Definition details retrieved", "{}", False
finalResultJson = "{}"
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expected = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    definition = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    metadata = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Blueprint response does not contain a Results array.")
    byMoid = {}
    for row in rows:
        moid = row.get("Moid") if isinstance(row, dict) else ""
        if not moid or moid in byMoid:
            raise ValueError("Blueprint response contains a missing or duplicate Moid.")
        byMoid[moid] = row
    if set(byMoid) != set(expected) or len(rows) != len(expected):
        status, statusCode, message = "relationship-mismatch", 409, "Referenced blueprint read did not return the exact relationship set."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "expectedCount": len(expected), "returnedCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        ordered = [byMoid[moid] for moid in expected]
        finalResultJson = json.dumps({"definition": definition, "metadata": metadata, "blueprintDetails": ordered}, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        resultJson = finalResultJson
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True
